text:
maria-cs: AegisWare onboarding goes live 2026-04-02. They need a short EU burst and a regional failover config. Request: aggregate +300 QPS split across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 (prefer 150/150), add partner CIDRs, exempt SSO callback header (x-aegis-sso). Can infra apply edge+origin policy?
tony-net: Affirmative. Please confirm exact start (UTC) and duration. Also, do they want session affinity for the SSO callbacks?
maria-cs: Start 2026-04-02 06:30 UTC, duration 36h. Yes to session affinity for callbacks. Auto-revoke 48h after window end. CIDRs below.
remy-eng: Quick engineering note 026-04-02: For edge+origin lifts we should watch KV cache pressure and cookie pinning. Recommend sticky routing header: `x-aegis-session` and a gradual ramp: 0 -> 100 -> 200 -> 300 over 20m. If customer insists on instant, we'll need aggressive monitoring.
maria-cs: AegisWare prefers a phased ramp: eu-west first to 150 immediate, then eu-central to 150 after 15m. They signed off on session affinity header.
tony-net: Preparing config. CIDRs:
```
198.51.100.0/24
203.0.113.128/25
2001:db8:feed::/48
```
Patch preview (internal only):
```
PATCH /api/internal/v1/customers/aegisware/config
{
  "regions": ["eu-west-1", "eu-central-1"],
  "rate_lift": {
    "per_region_qps": {"eu-west-1":150, "eu-central-1":150},
    "window_start": "2026-04-02T06:30:00Z",
    "duration_hours": 36,
    "ramp_plan": "phased"
  },
  "edge_origin": "both",
  "session_affinity_header": "x-aegis-session",
  "allowlist": ["198.51.100.0/24", "203.0.113.128/25", "2001:db8:feed::/48"],
  "header_exempt": ["x-aegis-sso"],
  "auto_revoke_hours_after_window": 48
}
```
ops-bot: Ticket created CS-4999. Temporary lift scheduled; auto-revoke configured (48h post-window). Playbook link: https://redwood.local/cs/playbooks/aegisware-onboard (internal).
rlift-bot: Rate lift queued for aegisware: eu-west-1 -> 2026-04-02T06:30:00Z (+150), eu-central-1 -> 2026-04-02T06:45:00Z (+150). Expires: 2026-04-04T18:30:00Z (auto-revoke +48h). Monitoring hooks: per-region p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit-rate, session-affinity mismatches, and SSO error logs. Ticket: CS-4999 :rocket:
tony-net: Deployed to edge canaries. Added sticky cookie routing and extra trace span on SSO callback path. Will watch tail latency and 5xxs.
maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll run the enablement call at +4h and schedule a 24h check-in. Renewal note: renewal in 2.5 months; flag as medium risk pending pilot outcome. Please capture feedback on latency and session drops.
remy-eng: Captured follow-ups: 1) if p99 > 800ms, rollback to pre-lift; 2) if SSO error rate >0.5% sustain for 15m, rollback header exemption.
maria-cs: Closing loop here. I9ll update AegisWare and post a short post-pilot survey in CS playbook. :white_check_mark:
